rationale: Encapsulating normalization in a utility module provides a clean, testable interface.
Avoids the significant performance and dependency overhead of Levenshtein-based fuzzy matching.
Standardized names allow for more predictable declarative filtering of repository paths.
Enables rapid prototyping of task matching without managing complex external library states.
Reduces supply chain risk by avoiding unnecessary third-party dependencies like 'thefuzz'.
Sensible middle ground: provides 'liberal' matching without the magic/unpredictability of full fuzzy logic.
